detailed_descriptions.en: Roulette Dungeon is a turn-based roguelike where you spin a roulette wheel to defeat your enemies. Master the balance between strategic planning and unpredictable luck by placing bets, using special abilities, and collecting items to outsmart your foes and conquer the dungeon. SPIN YOUR WHEEL TO VICTORY! Find items to create tons of unique playstyles, collect chips to place your bets & use all of your resources (and a little bit of luck) to defeat your enemies! CONQUER THE DUNGEON! Unique take on the roguelike genre with a focus on roulette mechanics! A variety of characters, each with their own abilities & strengths! Countless different item combinations leading to a vast amount of unique playstyles! Place bets to earn more chips & increase your chances of success! Spend your well earned chips for upgrades, on the slot machine, to play the shell game & more!
